source_packets.claim: East China energy regulator states current VPP registration, trading and settlement still contain bottlenecks and calls for breaking cross-province technical and settlement barriers.
Shandong reports the first substation-area storage VPP frequency-regulation trade and explicitly says it is working to solve the difficulty of small scattered resources entering market transactions.

Guangdong reports five generation-side VPP trading units entering spot trading, defines aggregation of dispersed charging, HVAC, storage and distributed renewables, and reports 47 VPP operators reviewed/publicized across four batches.

Shandong requires ongoing flexible-resource surveys and response-resource libraries, classifies aggregation by resource type and clearing node, requires operators to offer flexible retail packages and benefit sharing, and supports platform/algorithm service providers.

Current Shandong market rules require VPP public registration; aggregated resources are recorded with resource type and access-point/unit information, and resources are registered through the trading/load-management systems under standardized aggregation-unit rules.

Shandong rules provide a standardized market path in which VPPs and aggregated resources establish aggregation service relationships through the power trading platform, with node and capability constraints determining aggregation-unit eligibility.

A current public question asks whether household PV plus storage can aggregate and trade; the regulator confirms household distributed PV with storage should aggregate into a distributed-generation aggregation unit.

Customs expands 9610 cross-customs-area returns nationwide from 2026-04-01; return goods may use any eligible customs-supervised site and participating businesses must expose or integrate operational system data with Customs.

Official interpretation says traditional cross-border ecommerce returns were difficult, costly and slow; firms can choose return ports by logistics cost/time, with 381,300 return shipments and RMB94 million value during the pilot through February 2026.
Weihai's return center warehouse processed 26,000 returns in a year and reports reducing a formerly roughly 40-day return cycle to about one week, but this is already an incumbent operating route.

A platform participant states the new regime lets the platform choose the optimal return port using real-time logistics conditions, weakening the case that port selection itself is an unowned missing edge.

MIIT directs integration of local idle/dispersed compute through China computing platforms, precise SME demand-supply matching, flexible token/card-hour charging, intelligent matching and one-stop selection/procurement.
The national computing internet service platform is already the public control surface for computing resource/service discovery, materially compressing a generic independent compute router.

MIIT assigns producer recovery responsibility, requires public recovery-service networks, restricts used batteries to lawful comprehensive-utilization enterprises, and mandates battery-code/source/destination reporting through the information platform.

field_comparison.reason: Regenerative field and standardized rails are evidenced; exact incumbent ownership, permissioned data access and independent capture remain open.
Flow is regenerative but current platform evidence already shows optimized port selection; independent missing edge not proven.
MIIT-designated national/platform surfaces already provide pooling, matching and one-stop procurement.
Producer responsibility, regulated recovery networks and physical safety chain dominate operator control.
